search_text: published ZDI-14-232 ZDI-CAN-2088 Hewlett-Packard Intelligent Management Center SyslogDownloadServlet Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2014-07-16 CVE-2014-2619 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-2619 7.8 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Intelligent Management Center'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Intelligent Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SyslogDownloadServlet servlet. title: Hewlett-Packard Intelligent Management Center SyslogDownloadServlet Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Intelligent Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SyslogDownloadServlet servlet. This servlet contains a directory traversal issue which allows any file readable by SYSTEM to be disclosed. By abusing this behavior, an attacker can disclose administrative credentials and possibly leverage this situation to achieve remote code execution.
